hook: A Breakthrough Natural Solution That Supports A Healthy Memory Well Into Old Age
claim: Synaptigen is a memory supplement built on probiotics: a melt-in-the-mouth tablet with three probiotic strains, prebiotic fiber and peppermint. It's based on the gut-brain axis idea, that gut bacteria influence brain health.
ing_note: One strain is named precisely (B. lactis BL-04), which is better than most products, but CFU counts are not disclosed.
use: One tablet a day, dissolved in the mouth or chewed slowly.
price_note: Synaptigen is sold as 2 bottles, 2+1 or 3+3 bottles, with free shipping on 6-bottle orders; totals appear on the order page.
refund_note: For a refund you must return all bottles, empty or not, with the packing slip.
bonuses: Two further bonus guides with the 6-bottle package
checks: The gut-brain axis is a real research area; a few small trials of specific probiotic strains showed modest improvements in memory test scores.
These results depend on the exact strain and dose; Synaptigen's L. paracasei and L. reuteri strains aren't specified.
No probiotic has been shown to prevent dementia.
Melt-in-the-mouth tablets may be a poor way to deliver probiotics, which need to survive to the gut.
pros: Based on a real (if early) area of research
verdict: Synaptigen is more grounded than many memory products, but the evidence for probiotics and memory is still early and strain-specific. The 180-day guarantee is generous. Proven ways to protect memory include physical activity, managing blood pressure and hearing loss, staying socially active and good sleep; see a doctor about memory changes.
